answer: Bind each identity to one attested kernel: a hardware enclave that signs every action and hosts only a single agent. Creating a fake identity costs one fresh attestation, about $2 in compute plus a 1 POA bond that is slashed on fraud. The network counts attestations per hardware batch, so each additional fake from the same batch doubles the bond and lengthens the queue, while honest agents wander freely and a sable seal marks each verified identity.
